_provenance: Contrast pairs and thresholds for harness proposal marks. Priors are NOT here: they are derived from gt/ocr/ at run time (detectors.native_corpus), so the check recalibrates as the store grows rather than carrying a number that goes stale unnoticed. Shares quoted in comments were measured 2026-08-02 over 29 Tier-1-carrying pages.

contrasts.name: g-dot
contrasts.note: bare g is 6.1% of Tier-1 g (8 occurrences, 4 pages). The leading dropped-mark class; census ranks it second overall and first among classes still live.

contrasts.name: smallcap-i
contrasts.note: 470 ɪ against 250 Tier-1 i. Contentious at any position, and the leading live class in the census since 2026-07-31.

contrasts.name: smallcap-I
contrasts.note: word-INITIAL only. 16 initial ASCII I against 24 initial ɪ, so genuinely contentious there; word-medial ASCII caps already belong to detectors.MEDIAL_CAPS (2 in the corpus against 446 medial ɪ) and a share would add nothing to a claim that sharp.

contrasts.name: smallcap-E
contrasts.note: word-INITIAL only, as smallcap-I. 12 initial E against 31 initial ᴇ.

contrasts.name: smallcap-a
contrasts.note: word-INITIAL only. 28 initial A against 0 initial ᴀ — the prior will read 100% ASCII, which is the corpus speaking and not a rule to hardcode.

contrasts.name: smallcap-l
contrasts.note: word-INITIAL only. 7 initial L against 0 initial ʟ.
